title: 455. Design Phone Directory

examples.explanation: Single number handed out, checked, released, handed out again.
Third get finds the pool empty.

hints: Keep a boolean taken/free array plus the count of free numbers.
get scans from 0 upward for the first free entry; record -1 when the scan fails.
check maps free to 1 and taken to 0; release only clears a taken entry.
